metadata.scope: Every data row in the official published China-City-List CSV; city/county/district weather locations, including listed HK/MO districts and TW townships. This is not a complete village list or a claim of current civil-administration completeness.
metadata.coordinates: Unmodified coordinates from the source CSV. Legacy Beijing/Tianjin/Guangzhou aliases retain their pre-existing application coordinates separately.
metadata.use: Official publicly downloadable location list retained for this local application with source attribution; no license is inferred for public redistribution.
metadata.dynamicFallback: Open-Meteo official geocoding API (GeoNames data); ambiguous results require a selection.
